metadata.notes: Manual nostálgico post-Repeal de Ira D. Altschul (Santa Barbara, CA). Reflexiona sobre cómo durante la Prohibición se servía 'rotten and rancid poison' como whisky, y ahora hay que 'teach the people how and what to drink'. Incluye una sección sobre el setup ideal del bar pre-Prohibición (glasses, tools, fruit handling). Cocktails recopilados antes de la Prohibición.

sections.title: Hints in the Art of Mixing + Bar Setup
sections.title_es: Consejos del arte de mezclar + setup del bar
sections.content_original: Ira D. Altschul (Santa Barbara, CA) reflexiona post-Repeal sobre la 'rotten and rancid poison' que se servía como whisky durante la Prohibición. Ahora hay que 'teach the people how and what to drink'. Setup ideal del bar pre-Prohibición: shaved ice para spirits, lumps para drinks con eggs/milk/wine. Glassware: Whiskey, Old Fashion, Sour/Star/Snit, Footed Hi-Ball, Pony, Pousse Cafe, Port, Sherry, Rhine, Burgundy, Champagne (hollow stem and Cup), Punch, Goblet, Split, Beer, Fizz, Punch, Collins. Sección 'For the Morning after' incluye Bromo Seltzer, Absinthe frappé, A Red Raven Split, A bottle of beer uncorked the night before (No kid).
sections.content_es: Ira D. Altschul (Santa Barbara, CA) reflexiona post-Repeal sobre la mala calidad del whisky durante la Prohibición. Setup detallado del bar pre-Prohibición y glassware. 'For the Morning after' incluye Bromo Seltzer, Absinthe frappé, beer uncorked the night before.

Champagne

Use the hollow stem champagne glass if available.
If not, use ordinary stem punch glass.
Place one lump of sugar at bottom of glass.
Two or three dashes Angostura bitters on sugar.
One cube or lump of ice on top of sugar.
One strip of lemon peel squeezed on top of ice and left in glass.
Pour wine on top of this mixture and serve.
One pint of wine will serve four in this manner.
One quart will serve eight.

Place a pony glass of absinthe into a large glass; take the top
part of a French absinthe glass, which is shaped like a bowl and
which has a small hole in the bottom; fill this with fine shaved
ice and water, and it will drip through the hole into the glass
containing the absinthe; let it continue dripping until there is
about two parts water and one part absinthe, remove the pony
glass and serve; Only genuine imported absinthe should be used.
